findings.title: Defensive HTTP headers missing on frontend
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options headers not present on frontend. HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are present.
findings.business_impact: Low - existing HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options provide baseline browser protection
findings.remediation_reference: Add CSP and X-Frame-Options headers to frontend configuration
